Konclude's taxonomy lacks Image_type ≡ Image_with_uji_office_door and Image_with_uji_fire_extinguisher ≡ Image_with_uji_fireext_and_door, which HermiT and NRESE (classification driver, package 3.4) have. Justification, checked by hand: Image_type ≡ {corridorTI_3}; is_container_of(corridorTI_3, Object_2); has_colour(Object_2, grey); has_shape(Object_2, Object_2_Shape); Shape_type(Object_2_Shape); Object_2_Shape has_point four points, pairwise different (DifferentIndividuals over all 60 points), and line_line ≡ {the 60 points} with 56 NegativeObjectPropertyAssertions excluding the others: so =4 has_point.line_line, Quadrilateral; is_completely_inside is is_container_of's inverse, so Object_2 is completely inside an Image_type and a UJI_Office_Door, and corridorTI_3, the only Image_type, an Image_with_uji_office_door; Image_with_uji_fire_extinguisher ⊑ Image_type then gives the second equivalence. Konclude misses the closed count (at-most through negative assertions and nominals).
